description: Withdraw an earlier assertion, returning the lot to what the engine derived. Names exactly one of --target-key (a seed), --source-transfer-id (an edit), or --transfer-id (a designation).

anchorOriginLotId.description: Origin lot on the edited lot, when it has one

smartAccountId.description: Account id the lot belongs to (from 'accounts list')

sourceTransferId.description: Transfer an edited lot opened from

targetKey.description: Target key of a seeded lot

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: accounting_assertions_revoke
